<!-- External code contributions are limited to bug fixes and performance improvements.
New features, intentional behavior changes, and major structural changes are implemented
by the maintainer. Propose them in an issue instead. See CONTRIBUTING.md. -->

## Problem

Describe the bug or performance problem and link the relevant issue, if one exists.

## Change

Explain the fix and how it preserves intended behavior.

## Validation

Include reproduction steps or before-and-after performance measurements, the environment
and workload used, relevant regression tests, and the checks you ran.

Mention any compatibility considerations or limits of your verification.
